title: Building the ERM Framework
objective: Design and sequence an enterprise risk management framework that integrates with how the organisation decides.

Prevents aggregation.
Gets compliance, not adoption.

steps.prompt: How do you get risk into strategic decisions rather than after them?

debrief.summary: You designed an ERM framework that changes how decisions are made.

Integration into decisions is the test of ERM.

Never withhold a live material incident from the board.
